item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting that suggests internal cognition through color, contrast, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Use a deep midnight-blue and near-black ground, crossed by restless strokes of hot coral, electric teal, pale ochre, and chalk white. Let dense, dry-brushed marks gather and collide in a loose, off-center spiral of motion, with translucent washes drifting outward and thin scratches interrupting heavier patches. Set abrupt areas of silence against bursts of layered activity; vary the scale and tempo of the brushwork so the surface feels alert, uncertain, and continually rearranging itself. Keep the composition purely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Fill the entire square image with paint, with no border, frame, wall, room, or gallery setting."}
